top_signals.title: Oil, Energy Common Denominator to Market Risks: Citi
top_signals.summary: Beata Manthey, head of European equity strategy at Citi, examines the impact of rising energy prices on bonds and equities. She calls geopolitics “the biggest risk out there” but sees “quite an optimistic pass through” once that is resolved. She speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.summary: Nuveen is planning its first sterling bond sale, along with three dollar-denominated issues, to fund the buyout of UK money manager Schroders.

top_signals.title: Norway's Arctic Oil Pitch Falls Flat in Brussels
top_signals.summary: The European Commission is expected to keep its current ban on oil and gas drilling in the Arctic despite months-long campaigning from Norway to lift the moratorium, a spokesperson for the EC has told Euronews. The Commission, the European Union’s legislative arm, is expected to announce a revamped Northern Neighbourhood strategy on October 20.
